英文法規名稱: Regulations Governing Industrial Benefit Sharing for Non-Specific Use of National Health Insurance Data
中文法規名稱: 全民健康保險資料特定目的外利用產業利益回饋辦法
沿革內容: 1.Promulgated on August 7,2026, in accordance with the Ministry of Health and Welfare Order Wei-Pu-Pao-Tzu No. 1151260384. Promulgation shall take effect on August 10, 2026.

法規內容.條文內容: Regulations Governing Industrial Benefit Sharing for Non-Specific Use of National Health Insurance Data (hereinafter referred to as the “Regulations”) are promulgated pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 2 of Article 15 of the National Health Insurance Data Management Act (hereinafter referred to as  the “Act”).

For the purposes of the Regulations , “Industrial Benefits” refer to the following benefits, pursuant to Paragraph 1 of  Article 11 of the Act, arising from an applicant’s acquisition of domestic or foreign copyrights, patent rights, trade secret rights, or other intellectual property rights based on the results obtained from the use of National Health Insurance data (hereinafter referred to as “NHI data”) for purposes other than the specific purposes for which the data were collected (hereinafter referred to as the “specific purposes”):
1. Licensing fees or royalties received from licensing the use of such rights to the industry.
2. Redemption prices received from the assignment of such rights.
3. Equity acquired through the contribution of such rights as investment capital in the industry.
4. Any other pecuniary interests.
The applicant referred to in the preceding paragraph does not include government-commissioned universities, legal persons, or institutions prescribed in  Paragraph 1 of  Article 11 of the Act.

Where the applicant has been approved by the competent authority or the National Health Insurance insurer (hereinafter referred to as the “Insurer”) to carry out the use of NHI data for purposes other than the specific purposes, and the results obtained from such use generate any of the Industrial Benefits prescribed in the various subparagraphs of Paragraph 1 of the preceding article within fifteen years from the date of application, the applicant shall allocate a certain proportion as a benefit-sharing contribution, which shall be incorporated into the National Health Insurance Fund.

The benefit-sharing contributions shall be calculated by the competent authority or the Insurer, taking into account the purposes and methods of the applicant’s use of NHI data for purposes other than the specific purposes, the expected Industrial Benefits to be generated, and other relevant factors, at a rate of no less than ten percent of the actual Industrial Benefits generated. Where the actual Industrial Benefits to be generated are difficult to predict, the calculation method shall be agreed upon in an administrative contract between the applicant and the competent authority or the Insurer.

Where the applicant generates Industrial Benefits, it shall report the monetary value of such Industrial Benefits to the competent authority or the Insurer and provide any relevant information. Where necessary, the competent authority or the Insurer may require the applicant to provide further explanations.
With respect to the report referred to in the preceding paragraph, the competent authority or the Insurer may, regularly or from time to time, audit the rights acquired by the applicant, the manner in which such rights are exercised and any relevant records of exercising such rights, financial statements, account books, relevant documents, and other relevant data. The applicant shall not evade, obstruct, or refuse such audits.

The Insurer shall regularly disclose the Industrial Benefits, benefit-sharing contributions, and other relevant information arising from the use of NHI data for purposes other than for the specific purposes.
These Regulations shall take effect  on August 10, 2026.
